title: ononis natrix subsp. hispanica
intro: Ononis natrix subsp. hispanica, commonly known as Spanish restharrow, is a plant species in the legume family, known for its medicinal properties and uses in traditional folk medicine. The health benefits of Spanish restharrow include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as a demulcent, protecting and soothing mucous membranes, and as a hemostatic, promoting blood clotting and stopping bleeding. The bioactive constituents of Spanish restharrow include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects and potential therapeutic applications.
